subject.S24: explicit third cognition epoch, World-observed clearance 180cm; WAIT=4 MOVE_AWAY=7, WAIT admitted

wait_acknowledgement.authorization: explicit caller WaitAuthorityScope.ACKNOWLEDGE scoped to original S24 evidence

explicit_recheck.authority: separate explicit caller WaitAuthorityScope.REEVALUATE scoped to new evidence
explicit_recheck.comparison_rule: WAIT=2*risk when clearance<=100cm else risk; MOVE_AWAY=7

negative_controls: non-WAIT cognitive trace cannot create WAIT gate
non-ADMITTED S24 decision, inconsistent score, wrong stages/retained revision
recheck with same evidence/provenance or wrong World Action/binding/session/consequence source
observation before acknowledgement, after gate expiry, or after recheck time
expired WAIT receipt does not itself trigger recheck
missing/denied/wrong-scope recheck authority or acknowledgement authority reuse
changed Intent event history, missing Current Intent, terminal/stale recovery Skill
unexpected new open Action prevents recheck
limitations: Wait gate is a caller-held immutable receipt, not durable owner registry; repeated separate caller calls can replay the same gate/evidence unless caller enforces uniqueness
Deadline is a validation bound only; no timer or event scheduling occurs
Evidence and time are caller-supplied; no verified source-native Minecraft World sensor or cryptographic authority
Decision WAIT is an explicit non-Action disposition, not guaranteed safe waiting in World
Separate recheck may select MOVE_AWAY but that selection itself cannot propose, authorize or issue Action
WAIT reevaluation uses S24 fixed comparison criterion and frozen rev1/4, not learnt policy or continuous autonomous agent
Frozen S18-S24, RelayTheory R6 and Paper2 MAIN40 untouched
